subject: Proposal: staged capacity tranches, temporary price-hold and commit concessions
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@brightcart.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alan Rivers <alan.rivers@brightcart.com>, BrightCart Procurement <procure@brightcart.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0500
Subject: Renewal + expansion request — capacity uplift and price-hold ask

Hi Soojin,

Hope you’re well — BrightCart’s annual renewal is coming up and we need to align on two things quickly: 1) a material capacity uplift (we plan to double our committed tokens/embeddings over the next 12 months), and 2) a short-term price protection while we finalize internal budgeting.

High level: we’re prepared to move from our current commitment (~$120k/mo) to a staged commit that grows in three tranches over Q1-Q3 next year. Before we lock the new commit, our finance team is asking for a 3–6 month price-hold on current unit rates so we don’t face mid-quarter volatility while the budget is approved.

Specific asks:
- 3-month price-hold on current rates (ideally starts on renewal date) while we finalize PO and commit details
- Bridge credits to offset overage risk in the first tranche (we expect a spike during onboarding)
- Option to convert credits to committed volume after 6 months if we exceed threshold

I attached our renewal RFP and a short forecast. Can Redwood outline a proposal that combines a staged commit (tranche-based increases), explicit bridge credits, and a defined price-hold window? Also include any SLA or surge protections for the ramp.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Liu
Head of Product Operations, BrightCart
emma.liu@brightcart.com

Attachment: BrightCart_RFP_2026.pdf
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@brightcart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion request — capacity uplift and price-hold ask

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear summary and the RFP. We can absolutely design a staged-commit path with bridge credits and a short price-hold; I’ve sketched a conservative commercial we think balances BrightCart’s budget timing with Redwood’s capacity planning.

Proposed (high-level):
- Staged commits: 3 tranches (T1: +25% baseline, T2: +50% baseline, T3: +100% baseline) over a 9-month calendar (detailed cadence in attached draft MAP).
- Bridge credits: one-time pool equal to 10% of projected T1 spend (applies to overages in first 90 days post-renewal).
- Temp price-hold: 90 days from renewal on current unit rates for the committed SKU. After 90 days, rates roll to the new committed pricing unless a PO for the full year is executed earlier.
- Discounting: we can offer a time-limited 8% recurring discount on the committed volume for year 1 if BrightCart signs the full 12-mo commit within 60 days of the renewal date.
- SLA: include standard 99.9% availability for hosted inference; surge routing options available as add-on.

I attached a Draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a rough price model. Can you confirm: 1) whether finance needs a 6-month hold (vs our proposed 90 days), and 2) BrightCart’s expected PO timeline?

If they need 6 months we can explore a blended approach: a 90-day hard price-hold plus a 90-day limited protection (rate ladder that caps increases to +5% during months 91–180). That would require a modest increase to the bridge credit or a slight reduction to the sign-by discount.

Happy to hop on a call tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: Redwood_Draft-MAP.pdf, price_model_brightcart.xlsx
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Renewal + expansion request — capacity uplift and price-hold ask (internal pricing/approval)

Team — forwarding BrightCart’s ask and my preliminary commercial. Quick notes and asks:

Quoted above: 8% sign-by discount (if they sign 12-mo commit in 60 days), 90-day hard price-hold, 10% bridge credit on T1 spend. Alternative: 90-day hard + 90-day capped increase (+5%) for finance comfort if they insist on a 6-month window.

Approve? Need to confirm:
- Ben: finance signoff on bridge credit math (10% of T1 as one-time credit) — does this materially change FY revenue recognition / ARC? Recommend we classify as contra-revenue credits drawn down vs overages.
- Karthik: ops impact — can we commit to surge routing and an SLA carveout for the T1 ramp? If we add the 90d/90d ladder we should lock a small burst pool for onboarding so the customer’s UX is protected.
- Monica: legal/contract ask — do we need a limited-term amendment (annex) vs a full amendment to the SOW? Also confirm DocuSign timeline if the PO is delayed beyond 60 days.

I’ll hold the 8% discount on the table unless we decide to trade it for a larger bridge credit. They indicated they may request a 6-month price-hold — if so, I’d prefer 90d hard + 90d cap (+5) and reduce sign-by discount to 6%.

Thanks — Soojin
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@brightcart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Alan Rivers <alan.rivers@brightcart.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 16:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion request — capacity uplift and price-hold ask

Hi Emma — thanks for the RFP and for outlining timelines. We ran this quickly with pricing/ops/legal and can offer a concrete path that should meet BrightCart’s budget window while protecting both sides operationally. Summary below; I’ve attached a clean SOW and the updated price model.

What Redwood can commit to (summary):
1) Staged commit cadence (example):
   - T1 (months 0–3): +25% vs current baseline — bridge credit pool equal to 10% of projected T1 spend to cover onboarding overages.
   - T2 (months 4–6): +50% vs baseline (convert bridge credits to committed volume if thresholds hit).
   - T3 (months 7–12): +100% vs baseline (final commit).
2) Price protection:
   - Hard price-hold for 90 days from renewal date on current unit rates.
   - If BrightCart requires a 6-month protection window, we can offer a blended protection: 90-day hard hold + 90-day capped increase (max +5% on unit rates months 91–180). This reduces downside for Redwood while giving finance additional runway.
3) Discount: 8% recurring discount on committed volume for year 1 if BrightCart signs the 12-mo commit and returns a PO within 60 days of renewal. If they require the blended 6-month protection the sign-by discount would adjust to 6%.
4) SLA & surge: include standard 99.9% availability on hosted inference. We’ll provision a temporary burst pool in T1 (ops to size) and include surge routing rules in the MAP.
5) Contracting and next steps:
   - We’ll issue an amendment (annex) to the current SOW — not a full renegotiation. See attached SOW_v3.pdf.
   - DocuSign path: once BrightCart confirms tranche schedule and PO timing (60 or 180 days), we’ll prepare an annex and price exhibit.

Requested from BrightCart:
- Confirm whether finance needs full 180-day protection or if a 90d hard + 90d capped is acceptable.
- Preferred PO return target (60 days preferred to lock the 8%).
- Any specific requirements for evidence (SOC 2 artifacts / audit logs) tied to the renewal — ops/legal will surface anything material.

If that aligns, I’ll have legal and finance prep the annex and a DocuSign package by EOD tomorrow. Happy to review on a quick call — available 10–11am PT tomorrow.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out with you.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: SOW_v3.pdf, price_model_brightcart.xlsx
